finding: The English arm explains the entire construct and its alternatives; the marked arm is an uninstantiated form heading. This measures documentation-versus-heading length, not paired usage. No allegation of intent; no original arithmetic rewritten.

source_pair.english: Leading tags on any action instruction. "attempt: <X>" states the action should be executed and the instruction is satisfied by an honest failure report - English: "try to X; report either way." "ensure: <X>" states <X> must hold on completion - English: "make X true; do not stop at a failed attempt." Bare instructions stay legal and unmarked; the tag states the escalation contract explicitly when failure behavior is load-bearing.
